P31.answer: I did not see a clear בית. The word I take to be meant is my Stage 1 pos 6-9 (A x~785-1001): four letters ח-מ-ר-ה. It comes after a group at the right (Stage 1 pos 2-5, ב + box + V-shape + vertical) that might be the word read as בית, but I cannot confirm that.

P31.evidence: A x~954-1001: a roof with a long right leg. The left leg starts right under the left end of the roof and curves into it with no gap, so it looks joined (ח). There is no foot turning left, so ת is unlikely; ה would need a gap that I do not see. C strip 2 shows a closed arch here.

A x~883-934: a left upright rising above the line, a flat base, a right upright and a short roof stub. The left upright and the flat base rule out ב. CHANGE FROM STAGE 1: there I read this as ט (alt מ). The closer crop shows a flat base and a square box rather than a rounded base with an inner hook. C strip 1 shows a box with a flat base.

A x~832-868: a roof joining the right upright through a curved corner, with no projection to the right, so ר rather than ד. Caveat: there is an extra upright just to its left (x~841) with a small leftward hook at the top. If that upright belongs to this letter, it becomes ה/ח-like. In Stage 1 I read this area as מ (alt ט), so I am not confident.
A x~785-815: a roof and a right leg (which overtops the roof slightly). The left leg is short and starts clearly below the roof, so it is free = ה. C strip 1 agrees: the left leg is detached.

P35.answer: Possible match: Stage 1 pos 5-6 (A x~852-940, ב + a U-shaped letter with a knob at its top left) as the ב-נ word, with the knob letter possibly being the נ. The following word would then be pos 7-11: ו (x~824-840, probable), ו/ר (x~784-812, possible), ע (x~750-780, possible), ב (x~665-745, probable), and a small closed loop (x~624-662, possible).
P35.evidence: A enlarged; C strip 1 shows vertical, vertical-with-head, ע-like diagonal, box, small loop in that order.

P35.q: P35 last letter of that word
P35.answer: A small closed loop that sits low in the line. It is a closed shape, so it is closer to ם/מ or ט than to ב. Its rounded, loop-like outline slightly favours ט or a small ם. It is not a ב: the ב is the letter before it (x~665-745).
P35.evidence: A x~624-662 (work_R4/s2_P35_l.png): an oval loop with a short tail at the top left, smaller and lower than the neighbouring letters. C strip 1 shows a small loop at the strip edge.

P35.answer: Stage 1 pos 12-16 (A x~393-600), right to left: 1) a roofed letter at x~549-600; 2) a vertical with a hooked/rounded head at x~513-533; 3) ר at x~473-505 (roof with a rounded corner and a long leg); 4) ח/ת at x~425-465 (roof, two legs, with an upright crossing the roof at the left); 5) ו at x~393-411. Five letters.
P35.evidence: A enlarged x4.5; B strip 3 shows the same sequence of roofed, vertical and roofed forms.

P35.q: P35 first letter י, ט or ה
P35.answer: ה (alt ח). The letter has a roof with a long right leg and a left leg. There is also a third upright under the middle of the roof, so the segmentation is uncertain. If the small low loop (pos 11) belongs to this word instead, the first letter would be ט.
P35.evidence: A x~549-600: uprights at about x~553, ~578 and ~595 under one roof. The leftmost upright appears to reach the roof. Not י (too large).

P35.q: P35 second letter ה or ר
P35.answer: ר (alt ו). It is a vertical with a hooked head that curves to the left. It is not ה: there is no second leg.
P35.evidence: A x~513-533. B strip 3 shows a vertical with a head.

P35.q: P35 is there a ו and where
P35.answer: Yes. A clear ו is the last letter (5th, x~393-411). Possibly also a second ו at position 2 if that letter is ו rather than ר. In Stage 1 I read pos 13 as ו (alt ר) and pos 14 as ר (alt ו); I now see the same two letters, but I lean ר for the hooked one only weakly.
P35.evidence: A; B strip 3 vertical with top serif at the left end.

P49.answer: If the first word is pos 1-2 at the right (A x~1020-1125: ב + a cracked letter with a diagonal and a vertical that could be ק), then the second word runs from about x~868 to x~467. Right to left: (base-only letter at x~937-972, partly lost in the crack; ב/כ possible), ו/ר (x~897-922, possible), י (x~868-885, possible), ע (x~804-861, probable), ב (x~727-793, probable), ל (x~639-713, possible: ascender at the top left, slanted top, long base), then a letter at x~565-610 (see a), then a box at x~467-533 (see b).
P49.evidence: A enlarged x3.5 with contrast (work_R4/s2_P49_a.png, s2_P49_b.png). B/C X-rays too faint to help. Word boundaries are not visible.

A x~565-610: an upright (x~572) that starts above roof level and meets a short roof running right. The right part falls into the vertical strip seam (x~610-627), so the right leg is not visible. The left leg reaches the roof (joined) = ח rather than ה. CHANGE FROM STAGE 1: there I read this as ו/ז (a vertical with a dot). On re-inspection the roof stroke at its top is visible, and the seam may hide the right leg. A small dot sits just right of it (x~556).

P49.answer: Yes: a box-shaped letter at x~467-533 before a gap, then ב at x~376-436. Its left side seems curved and closed, so ם is possible; ב is also possible if the left side is only shadow.
P49.evidence: A x~467-533: roof, right upright, flat base and an apparent dark left edge. Stage 1 read it as ב (probable).

P49.answer: No cancelled letters seen. The only extra mark is a small dot at x~556 next to the letter in (a). It could be a stroke mark or corrosion, not a clear cancellation.
P49.evidence: A enlarged. No strike-through or dots over letters elsewhere.

P53.answer: Right to left (A x~833-1136): ב (x~1091-1136, possible), ק (x~1049-1083, possible), ו (x~1023-1036, possible), ו/ז (x~988-1020, possible: a knob head on a long stem), a box-like letter with a long left stroke (x~933-988, מ possible, alt ט/ק), ע (x~886-925, probable), ה (x~833-880, certain). Then a clear space before כ.
P53.evidence: A enlarged x3.8 with contrast (work_R4/s2_P53.png); C strip 1 shows two verticals, a box, a V-shaped ע and ה in that order.

P53.answer: Yes, probably ק: a head/roof at the top with a long stem descending below the line. A separate right side is not clearly seen, so ן or ר cannot be excluded. Stage 1 read this as ן (alt ו, ר); ק fits the long descender plus the roof.
P53.evidence: A x~1049-1083: roof at the top, upright going well below the baseline.

P53.answer: Yes: a single vertical at x~1023-1036 directly after the ק, followed by a second vertical with a knob head (x~988-1020), which could be another ו or ז.
P53.evidence: A; C strip 1 shows two verticals in this area.

P53.answer: Following letters in order: (ו/ז), then מ (possible; a box with a long left stroke, damaged), then ע (probable), then ה (certain). I see no ב between ע and ה.
P53.evidence: A; C strip 1 box, V-shape, ה.
A x~833-880: roof, right leg, and a short left leg clearly detached from the roof. C strip 1 agrees. A clear space follows.

P61.answer: Probably ב (x~1143-1205) followed by two uprights at x~1112-1130 and x~1071-1093. These could be the two legs of a ח whose roof is lost at the edge of the smooth patch, which matches 'ב-ח'. Further right, ח (x~1321-1371) and two strip ridges, which I take as belonging before this word or as seam artefacts.
P61.evidence: A enlarged with contrast (work_R4/s2_P61_r.png); C strip 3 shows a box (ב) and two verticals at the top of the strip.

P61.answer: None legible. From x~780 to x~1070 the line in A is covered by a smooth raised patch with no strokes on it. In C strip 2 and C strip 3 this area is black (metal missing). There is a single faint vertical trace at the right end of the gap (part of the possible ח legs).
P61.evidence: A smooth patch; C strips 2-3 black triangle; B does not cover this part of the line.

P61.answer: About 6-8 letter-spaces (gap width ~290 px; letters plus spacing here average ~40 px). The exact count cannot be determined.

P61.q: P61 visible traces of ש, ל, ד, י, א, ט, נ, ב
P61.answer: None of these is visible inside the gap. At the left edge of the gap (x~747-772) there is a rounded trace (a vertical curving into a base with a knob), which could be ט (possible) or ע/מ. No ש, ל, ד, י, א, נ or ב traces.
P61.evidence: A x~747-772; C strip 2 shows nothing there (dark).

P61.q: P61 last letter before next word
P61.answer: The rounded trace at x~747-772, ט possible (alt ע, מ). The next legible group starts with ו (x~725-730) then ת, ח, ו. If the rounded trace is instead the first letter of that next word, the last letter before it is lost in the gap.

P67.answer: I take the ה-ט word to be my ח (x~652-700, which could be ה) + ט (x~617-650) + ב + ל. The preceding word, right to left (A middle strip x~724-912): נ (x~870-912, possible), small י (x~868-880, possible), ק (x~826-852 with its descender at x~820-826, probable), ו (x~792-806, probable), and a roofed letter (x~724-768, ה possible, alt ח).
P67.evidence: A enlarged x5 with contrast (work_R4/s2_P67.png); B strip 3 shows box, ק-like hooked form, verticals, ח.

P67.answer: Two letters: an upright with a base running left (a short נ) plus a small separate stroke at the top (י). I do not see a roof or a left side closing a box, so not מ. CHANGE FROM STAGE 1: there I read this as כ (probable). On re-inspection there is no curved roof, only the upright and the base, and a small stroke sits above to the left. Caveat: B strip 3 shows this letter somewhat box-like, so מ cannot be fully excluded.
P67.evidence: A x~868-912; B strip 3 x-ray shows an upright and a base with a faint top.

P67.answer: ו (x~792-806), a plain vertical. It is followed by the roofed letter (x~724-768).
P67.evidence: A; B strip 3 verticals after the hooked form.

P67.answer: It ends with a roofed letter: a roof, a right leg, and a left leg that seems to start just below the roof (free), so ה is possible (alt ח). A stroke descending below the line just right of it (x~775) may belong to it or to the ק. In Stage 1 I read this area as ר + ק (pos 12-13); the ק I now place at x~826-852.
P67.evidence: A x~724-778; B strip 2 shows a W-like form here that I could not resolve.

P72.answer: First word: ב (x~1094-1144, probable) + a letter with a tall upright rising above the line and a diagonal from the upper right (x~1046-1096). That second letter could be the ש (possible; Stage 1 read it as ק/א). Second word, right to left: a letter with a teardrop/looped head on a long stem (x~1015-1036, ל possible: rounded ascender top as in P35 ל; alt ר/ף), then the roofed letter of (a) (x~965-1010), a short upright with a base running left (x~938-975, נ possible), a vertical with a diagonal (x~907-949, ע/צ possible), ב with a loop above (x~817-888, possible), and ו/ן (x~787-800, possible). Then a clear space.
P72.evidence: A enlarged x3.8 with contrast (work_R4/s2_P72.png); C strip 2 outlines.

A x~965-1010: a roof with a right leg (x~1007). The left upright (x~973) runs up through and above the roof, so the left leg is joined/crossing = ח, not ה. Caveat: the same upright continues down to a base running left, so it may be shared with the next letter. Stage 1 read this area as ר + נ/ל.

P72.answer: No closed box (ם) seen. After the roofed letter come an upright-with-base (נ-like) and a vertical-with-diagonal, then ב and ו before the space.
P72.evidence: A; C strip 2 shows a vertical + diagonal and a base, no closed box.

P72.answer: No cancelled letters seen. There is no strike-through. The loop above ב (x~833-850) looks like part of a letter (an ascender or head), not a cancellation dot.

P84.answer: Taking the first word of the left column (A x~775-990), right to left: ב (x~940-990, possible), ר (x~879-922, possible), a short stroke hanging below the left end of that roof (x~870-878, י possible; it could instead be the left leg of a ה), ר/ד (an upright at x~851-860 with a roof running left to x~807, possible), ו (x~800-807, possible), י (x~775-793, possible). Word boundaries are not visible, so the end of the word is uncertain. The short right-column group (Stage 1 pos 1-5, ל ה ב ו ק) is a separate column fragment.
P84.evidence: A enlarged x4.5 with contrast (work_R4/s2_P84_r.png); X-rays too faint here.

P84.q: P84a second letter ר or ד
P84.answer: ר: the right end of the roof curves down into the right leg (rounded corner), and nothing projects to the right of the leg. CHANGE FROM STAGE 1: there I read this as ה (probable). The short 'left leg' now looks like a separate small stroke (י) or a mark, but ה remains an alternative.

P84.q: P84a third letter ו, י or ר
P84.answer: י: a short stroke hanging from roof level at x~870-878, much shorter than full height. If it is not a separate letter, the third letter is the long upright at x~851-860, which has a roof running left, i.e. ר.
If the word ends before the next legible group, its last letter is the small diagonal stroke at x~775-793 (י, possible). I cannot locate the word end with confidence. It is not ן.
P84.evidence: A; no clear space visible in this cramped line.

P84.answer: Right to left (A x~392-616): ב (x~582-616, probable: roof, right upright, long base running far left), צ (x~542-570, possible: an upright with a curled arm at the top right sitting on the base), ו (x~513-532, possible: full-height vertical with a head), ו (x~492-504, possible), ח (x~440-480, possible: roof with two legs, the left one joined), then a letter with a descender (x~392-428, ק/ן possible). Stage 1 had pos 17 as ב covering x~524-611 (alt צ); the closer crop separates ב and צ.

P84.q: P84b third letter ו, י or ר
P84.answer: ו: a full-height vertical with a small head; it is not short like י and has no roof like ר.
No supralinear letter seen near this word. Above it there are only the bases of letters of the line above (dark horizontals at y~40-55).
P84.evidence: A enlarged; the space between the lines is otherwise clean.

P87.answer: Right to left (A x~490-725): ה (x~677-725, possible), ס (x~608-663, probable), ב (x~543-594, possible), ק (x~490-543, probable). CHANGE FROM STAGE 1: there I read the first letter as ו (probable, alt ן). The closer crop shows a roof with a left leg that stops just short of it (free). The right leg coincides with the long vertical stroke that crosses the line here (x~700), so ה is possible. Preceded by a short horizontal stroke/dot (x~755-768).
P87.evidence: A enlarged x4.5 with contrast (work_R4/s2_P87.png); C strip 1 shows the same roofed letter and the dot.

P87.answer: ב (weakly). The letter has a flat roof with a small hook at its left, a straight right upright, a square bottom-right corner and a flat base running well to the left. The base does not visibly project to the right of the upright, but the corner is square, not rounded. So it is not a typical rounded כ either.
P87.evidence: A x~543-594; C strip 2 shows a box with a square corner.

P87.answer: The last letter is ק, not ן. It has a roof with a right side descending to about mid-height, plus a separate long left stroke descending well below the baseline.
P87.evidence: A x~490-543: two components, the roof+right side and the long left descender. A gap (~27 px) follows before the next letter (כ).
